title: REQ · Submit is blocked with a clear message when the remaining quota is 0
summary: Block submit at zero quota with a message
description: Context: remaining is computed from sent entries but never gates submit. Desired behavior: when remaining is 0 the Send button and textarea are disabled and a message 'No contributions left this round' is shown. Expected result: no request at zero quota. Why: the player understands why they cannot send.
acceptance_criteria: Given 5 sent contributions, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled and 'No contributions left this round' is shown
Given 4 sent contributions, when the sheet renders, then Send is enabled and no quota message is shown
technical_constraints: Use existing remaining value derived from entries
definition_of_done: Zero quota blocks submit with message
